A modded version of Techtronika's Grad sniper rifle. Powerful enough to knock an AV out of the sky. A heavy-metal relic from real war.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Anti-Mat. Rifle

Damage: 8d6 • Capacity: 3 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Bipod, Power Rebuild, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Armor-Piercing Ammunition (50eb [Costly] per round) which also functions as Incendiary Ammunition and functions like an Explosive when interacting with Cover for the purposes of carrying damage to targets behind destroyed Cover. This weapon does not benefit from the x2 damage multiplier of Head Aimed Shots (It does benefit from this when attacking Vehicle weak spots, however). After this weapon is fired, an Action is required to work its bolt before it can be fired again. Requires BODY 12+ or, if the user is Prone, BODY 10+ to wield unless Mounted. Requires BODY 14+ to not reduce the user’s DEX and MOVE by 2 while wielded or held.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Anti-Mat. Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Power Rebuild, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
